purpose: Consolidated nonexecuted pilot decision contract, including all-stage budget and paired comparison. This is preparation only, not executable config or training prompt.
teaching_target: Approved bounded bilingual source-grounded answer patterns: correct question-to-fact association, protected identifiers, explicit source/observation/integration distinctions and warranted uncertainty. Not learning a general independent truth verifier or broad architecture competence in16updates.

proposed_data_not_created.initial_owner_review_floor: Four bilingual task pairs proposed historically; no actual training split approved.
proposed_data_not_created.source_family_policy: Current role registryV9 governs exclusions; old six-family/OpenRA-reserve statements are historical. Axum/OpenRA evaluation-only consumed, esp-hal metadata reserve; all current derivatives training-ineligible. Private VivaBem/EL material excluded.
proposed_data_not_created.future_evaluation: Owner-approved fresh source-family grouped tasks and references frozen before any new pilot model output. No tuning against evaluation outcomes.

matched_conditions_required: Same approved trainable checkpoint revision/tensors/tokenizer/template/framework/precision and hardware for unadapted versus adapter inference
Same source cut, prompt, sampling, context/output caps and complete-task acceptance criteria
Same frozen tasks with paired per-task outcomes, complete bilingual output and source-grounded review
Separate unchanged source-first deterministic reference; current OllamaQ4GGUF diagnostics not a causal adapter baseline

budget_contract.total_includes: All in-run baseline inference, data/template/mask checks, model/adapter load, optimizer work, adapter inference, scoring and persistence/verification; not optimizer-only time. No hidden extra evaluation window.
budget_contract.launch_precondition: Before future execution approval, establish a bounded task/output workload and conservative host-specific feasibility for the entire paired comparison/state preservation within1800seconds. Performance not established in this campaign.
budget_contract.reserve_requirement: Pre-authorized bounded optimizer start cutoff must leave measured/conservatively bounded time for adapter evaluation and state preservation. If no defensible reserve exists, do not update.
budget_contract.timeout_policy: Any incomplete baseline, post-adapter output, scoring or preservation yields INCOMPLETE/NO_GO, never a complete-acceptance improvement. No retry, task shrink, higher caps or budget widening without separate authorization.
budget_contract.not_verified: Native training/inference throughput, memory peak, checkpoint costs and total runtime

success_decision.primary: At least one complete frozen held-out documentation/FAQ task passes all applicable predeclared dimensions, and adapted accepted-task count strictly exceeds matched unadapted count on exactly the same completed task set.
success_decision.critical_guard: Any critical unsupported guarantee, false removal, private/right violation or false source approval disqualifies success; do not trade critical errors against acceptance count.
success_decision.nonregression: Identifier preservation, EN/PT coverage, per-claim support and warranted abstention must not regress under the frozen denominators. Report all paired outcomes and rejected/truncated/incomplete records.
success_decision.tie_or_baseline_ceiling: Tie in complete acceptance is not demonstrated learning. If baseline accepts all, use only a separately pre-frozen meaningful improvement criterion or report inconclusive; never change it after observing results.
success_decision.tiny_sample_limit: Feasibility evidence only, not general accuracy, independent truth verification or evidence of reliable full architectural documentation.

mandatory_runtime_data_state_gates: Allnine readiness gates verified and explicit separate launch approval; no automatic action from thisrecord
Approved local paths/hashes and no implicit model/data/default/remote fallback before entrypoint
Actual tokenizer/template prefix and complete real-token supervision verified; no prompt/padding supervision or lost targets, positive valid target count
Finite-loss/pre-update guard and actual adapter inventory/dtypes/resource limit verified under separate authorized implementation/runtime scope

Unique immutable run directory and every valuable checkpoint/output retained; adapter-only reload labeled new weights-initialized experiment unless full optimizer/RNG/cursor/iteration state restored and verified
Original serving model/datasets unaffected; no fusion/deployment/upload
current_actions: No framework import/install/distribution or newweights download, tokenization, optimizer, training, deployment or external request performed by this record. Public framework text references were previously downloaded separately and preserved; not a package installation.
owner_decisions_after_campaign: Training-target and rights approval separate from documentation approval
Trainable base/tokenizer/native framework/environment and installation/download scope
Independent matched evaluation and all-stage host resource budget
Specific future run authorization only after gates pass
